research_status: COMPLETE — all 366 episodes of the original Bleach TV series (2004-2012, pre-Thousand-Year Blood War) classified canon/filler/mixed. Sourced from a community-compiled Reddit breakdown, independently corroborated by a second Reddit thread with an identical canon/mixed/filler breakdown, cross-checked against a Radio Times filler-only guide which agreed on every episode except one (227, resolved in favor of the two-source Reddit agreement — see that episode's status_note). Bleach's later continuation (Thousand-Year Blood War, 2022-) is a separate AniList/MAL entry, not covered by this file.
